test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

My joy knew no ______ when I met my family after five years.
solution:
The correct answer is **'bounds'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct word for the given blank is **bounds. **
 
• **joy knew no bounds **is an idiomatic phrase that is used for emphasizing that it is very strong or intense. 
 
• Hence, **option 4 **is the correct answer. 
 
• The other given options do not form any meaning when used in the given blank.
